subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should OpenClaw pursue this card-based iPhone Control tab direction over the current native List-based Control hub?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not just code repair: the linked feature request is still open for product direction, current main has since adopted a native iOS structure, and accepting this PR would change the default Control tab visual model for all iPhone users.

options.title: Require design approval before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open only as a candidate until a maintainer approves the card layout, the branch is rebased, branded typography is restored, and visual proof is added.

options.title: Close as superseded by native direction
options.body: Close this PR and keep or close the linked feature request according to the current native iOS design direction.

options.title: Sponsor a narrower redesign
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that adapts only the approved parts, such as row density or icon treatment, on top of the current native List surface.

recommendation.title: Require design approval before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only as a candidate until a maintainer approves the card layout, the branch is rebased, branded typography is restored, and visual proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the most directly overlapping merged Control/Talk visual hierarchy work and supplied the current visual proof baseline.
